clips.title: The story
paras: At Lakeshire, a besieged garrison needs sturdy copper equipment from Ironforge. Tormus Deepforge asks aspiring Alliance smiths to forge the gear and help resident smith Verner Osgood defend the region from hostile orcs and gnolls.

At Ironforge's Great Forge, dwarven smiths know the Alliance's frontline struggles reach beyond Dun Morogh. In the Redridge Mountains, Lakeshire faces repeated attacks from Blackrock orcs marching from Stonewatch Keep and gnolls roaming the northern ridges. Royal reinforcements from Stormwind are slow to arrive, and local supplies remain dangerously low.

Lakeshire's resident blacksmith, Verner Osgood, works nearly alone at his outdoor forge, mending shattered armor and replacing broken weapons. Seeing the strain on his human counterpart, Tormus Deepforge asks developing smiths to bring four Runed Copper Belts and four Heavy Copper Mauls to Lakeshire. In return for bolstering the militia's defensive reserves, Verner teaches traveling craftsmen finer trade techniques.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We dwarves aren't the only ones fighting. Our human allies have their hands full too!

Redridge is under periodic attack from blackrock orcs, and their supply of equipment is always low. If you were to help them out, I'm sure their resident blacksmith, Verner Osgood, would teach you a trick or two.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I hope you're here with good news from Ironforge. Because I'm at my wit's end!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. This will help me out tremendously. With the Blackrock orcs attacking from Stonewatch Keep and the Redridge gnolls lurking in the foothills to the north, I'm always fixing armor and making new weapons for our troops.
The supplies you brought will give me a moment's peace. I will have enough time to teach you something...
